entry.title: [UPDATED] MAL-2026-17616: Malicious code in web3-eth-utils (RubyGems)
entry.content:
Malicious code in web3-eth-utils (RubyGems)

Affected:

  • web3-eth-utils

RubyGems runs this gem's native extension script `ext/req_throttle_mini/extconf.rb` during `gem install`. The script exits without action on CI runners and sandboxes, based on CI environment variables, the hostname, the username and the working directory. It continues if the system uptime is over 30 minutes and the home directory holds `.ssh`, `.gitconfig`, `.npmrc`, `.gem/credentials` or `.bundle`. It then decodes a Base64 Ruby payload, forks twice into a detached process, waits 20 to 40 minutes and opens a reverse shell that connects `/bin/sh` to 45.138.12.177 on TCP port 8089. The shell reconnects every 30 seconds. The Ruby code in `lib/` is a decoy. The RubyGems account `reqthrottle_3474` published this gem and 41 others with the same loader on 2026-10-05. --- _-= Per source details. …

References:

  • https://rubygems.org/gems/web3-eth-utils/versions/1.0.0
  • https://safedep.io/rubygems-crypto-gems-install-time-reverse-shell/
  • https://rubygems.org/gems/web3-eth-utils/versions/1.0.3
